name: Mumbai Central & Mithi River Basin
description: High-density urban flood hotspot encompassing the Mithi River catchment, Kurla junction, Dadar-Hindmata depression, Bandra-Kurla Complex (BKC), Sion lowlands, and Andheri subway corridors.

critical_hotspots.name: Hindmata - Dadar TT Circle
critical_hotspots.vulnerability: Extreme depression bowl; tidal lock vulnerable

critical_hotspots.name: Kurla West - LBS Marg & Station
critical_hotspots.vulnerability: Mithi river overflow confluence & dense rail/road junction

critical_hotspots.name: Andheri Subway & SV Road
critical_hotspots.vulnerability: Micro-depression subway prone to rapid flash-flooding

critical_hotspots.name: Mahim Bay & Mithi River Outfall
critical_hotspots.vulnerability: Tidal discharge lock during high spring tides

critical_hotspots.name: Santacruz Airport Catchment
critical_hotspots.vulnerability: High surface runoff generation into Vakola drainage
